dedupe_keys.name: country nuclear fuel cycle profiles second edition iaea technical reports series no 425 2005

description: Country Nuclear Fuel Cycle Profiles is the second edition, published by the IAEA in May 2005 as Technical Reports Series No. 425, of a compilation of country profiles on nuclear fuel cycle activities in a form understandable to experts and the public and meant to improve transparency of nuclear energy development. The first edition was published in 2001 showing the status at the end of 1999; the second edition shows the status at the end of 2002, prepared from available documents, comments from experts at a 2002 consultants meeting and a 2003 technical committee meeting, and responses to an IAEA circular note. It has two parts: a review of worldwide fuel cycle activities and the country profiles, which also include graphical representations of the flow of material. Coverage is IAEA member states that run fuel cycle activities, as of 2002. Access: free PDF from the IAEA publications site under a copyright notice requiring permission for reuse. Caveats: dated twenty years before the reading date, so facility status has changed. It suits background for nuclear fuel supply chain and capacity planning studies, and no directly related records are catalogued yet.
